description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) achieved by four variants of the MADLLM model across six different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset," lists these datasets in left-to-right order. The vertical axis, labeled "F1 Score (%)", is scaled linearly from 60 to 100 with major tick marks at 60, 70, 80, 90, and 100. For each dataset, four bars are grouped together, representing the performance of: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the datasets. The tallest bars are for the PSM dataset, where MADLLM (green) reaches approximately 97%, and for the SMD dataset, where MADLLM (green) reaches approximately 93%. The shortest bars are for the WADI dataset, where MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple) is approximately 61%, and MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue) is approximately 62%. The chart visually emphasizes the performance degradation when components are removed, as the bars for the modified models (purple, blue, orange) are consistently shorter than the baseline MADLLM (green) bar for each dataset.
